questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: Most schools in the city rely on private transport for students. Conclusions: I. The city has inadequate public transport. II. A transport strike may affect school attendance.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: Most schools in the city rely on private transport for students.

Conclusions: I. The city has inadequate public transport.

II. A transport strike may affect school attendance.
questions.solution:
Logic:

Conclusions:

If most schools depend on private transport, and if there’s a transport strike (affecting private transport services), then students may face difficulty reaching school.

So attendance would likely be affected.

So, Only I follows.

questions.question: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid. Statement: The development of renewable energy sources is crucial for sustainable growth, but high setup costs remain a challenge. I. Sustainable growth cannot be achieved without renewable energy sources. II. The setup costs of renewable energy sources are significantly high. III. Governments are not taking any steps to reduce setup costs.
